symptoms.title: Oval leaf spots
symptoms.description: Large oval or elongated spots may develop on banana leaves, often with brown or tan centers.

symptoms.title: Yellowish halos
symptoms.description: Lesions may be surrounded by yellowish areas that contrast with the healthy green tissue.

symptoms.title: Zonate patterns
symptoms.description: Some lesions may develop concentric or zonate patterns as they enlarge.

symptoms.title: Edge infection
symptoms.description: Lesions may occur near leaf margins and can expand into larger damaged areas.

treatment.title: Remove affected leaves
treatment.description: Remove severely affected plant material and dispose of it properly to reduce sources of infection.

treatment.title: Improve sanitation
treatment.description: Keep the growing area clean and remove infected plant debris.

treatment.title: Reduce leaf wetness
treatment.description: Improve airflow and avoid unnecessary prolonged wetness of banana leaves.

prevention.title: Maintain sanitation
prevention.description: Remove infected plant material and keep the area around banana plants clean.

prevention.title: Avoid prolonged leaf wetness
prevention.description: Good airflow and appropriate water management can help reduce conditions favorable to leaf diseases.

prevention.title: Monitor leaves regularly
prevention.description: Inspect leaves frequently so new lesions can be identified before they become extensive.

prevention.title: Remove infected debris
prevention.description: Dispose of heavily infected fallen leaves and plant material appropriately to reduce potential sources of infection.
